title: Newest good snapshot and off-host copy age, with a warning past the loss window
goal: The dashboard and nerv doctor show backup ages and warn when one is older than 24 h
acceptance: A test with a fake clock shows the ages and the warning at 24 h + 1 min
A failed snapshot does not reset the age (only a good one does)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the report sizes the age signal at 2 h. Not a measurement.
